verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web scraping, crawling and enrichment service, so resuming crawls from checkpoints is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents checkpointing or resuming a crashed run. The closest items are adjacent: SDK retries for 429s and transient GET failures, re-running an enrichment by enrichment_id, and a run.stopped webhook event. None of these resumes a partially completed crawl from saved state.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can resume a crashed deep crawl from a saved checkpoint instead of restarting from scratch
